title: Stop swallowing JSON parse errors in settings loader
prompt: loadSettings in src/settings.js silently swallows JSON parse errors and falls back to defaults, so callers cannot tell a broken settings string from an intentional empty one. Change it so that invalid JSON input throws an Error whose message includes the text 'invalid settings JSON' (keep the original parse error detail in the message). Valid JSON must keep merging over the defaults exactly as before. State a short plan before making changes.
